gaps.sentence: Her ___ (APPOINT) as captain surprised no one.
gaps.explanation: 'Her appointment as captain' — the event of being appointed.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
They're ___ (HOPE) that the talks will resume.
gaps.explanation: 'Be hopeful that…' = feeling hope; 'hopefully' is the adverb.

gaps.sentence: They searched the area ___ (SYSTEM) for clues.
Do not be ___ (PATIENT) with the trainees — everyone learns at a different pace.
gaps.explanation: 'Do not be impatient' — the negative adjective fits the advice against frustration.
